approach.title: How we build
approach.intro: Four rules. The same in every app.

account.title: No account needed
account.body: Download, open, use. No sign-up form, no password, no email verification.

device.title: Your data stays on your device
device.body: Your game and score data is stored on your phone, and nothing is sent to our servers. Free versions show Google AdMob ads; the Privacy Policy has the details.

offline.title: Plays offline
offline.body: Tabu Mabu needs no connection. It works on the road, in the mountains, or in a living room with no signal.

simple.title: A plain interface
simple.body: One job per screen. You start playing without getting lost in settings.

about.metaDescription: ustunsoft is an independent studio in Istanbul that builds mobile apps and games. How we work and what we care about.
about.title: About
about.lead: ustunsoft is an independent mobile app and game studio founded by Yasin Üstün in Istanbul.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: We build the apps we want to use ourselves. A word game anyone can open at a get-together, or a counter that keeps score without hunting for pen and paper.
story.p2: Our apps are published on Google Play. All of them work without an account, and the data you create stays on your device.

mission.title: Mission
mission.body: To build apps that make game nights and small everyday tasks easier, with no setup to fuss over.

focus.title: Less, done fully
focus.body: An app should do one job well. We don't add features nobody will use.

privacy.title: Respect for privacy
privacy.body: We don't ask for an account, and we don't send your game and score data to our servers. We also say plainly that the apps show ads.

feedback.title: We read feedback
feedback.body: We read every email that reaches the support address. Those messages shape the apps.

legal.metaDescription: How the information you send through the ustunsoft contact form is processed.
legal.title: Contact form privacy notice

data.title: What information is processed
data.body: The name, email address, subject and message you enter in the form. The form asks for nothing else; the site has no analytics tool or tracking cookies.

purpose.title: Why it is processed
purpose.body: Only to read your message, reply to you and resolve your support request. Your information is not used for marketing and is not sold.

basis.title: Legal basis
basis.body: Our legitimate interest in answering your request, under Article 5(2)(f) of the Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

where.title: Where it is processed
where.body: The form is sent through a service called Web3Forms, and your message is delivered to our inbox as an email. The servers of Web3Forms and of our email provider (Google) may be located outside Türkiye. Your message is not shared with anyone else.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.body: Your message is kept in our mailbox for up to two years after the conversation ends and is then deleted. If you want it deleted sooner, just write to us.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under Article 11 of the Law, you have the right to learn whether your data is processed, to request information about it, to ask for it to be corrected or deleted, to learn which third parties it was transferred to, and to object to the processing. You can send requests to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Turkish Personal Data Protection Board.
